title: NestJS (Enterprise Modular Backend)
summary: NestJS 10+, TypeScript (Strict), Prisma / TypeORM, Class-Validator, Jest
rules: Enforce module boundaries: every domain entity lives in its own module with dedicated controller, service, and DTOs.
Controllers strictly handle routing and request mapping; business logic and DB transactions belong in services.
Every incoming request payload must use a validated DTO class with class-validator decorators.
Use standard NestJS HTTP exceptions (NotFoundException, BadRequestException, etc.). Never expose raw DB errors.
Configuration and environment variables must be accessed via ConfigService with typed validation schemas.
